claims.statement: Tom Allen announced he would fight any man in America for $500 to $10,000, in a square stand-up fight under London prize ring rules.
claims.excerpt:
Tom Alten announces his readiness to fight any
man in America for trom $500 to $10,000

claims.statement: Tom Allen offered to meet Joe Coburn in the ring anywhere in Wyoming Territory, whom he called the leading scientific pugilist in the United States.
claims.excerpt:
He wil! moet Joe
Coburn in the ring, (anywhere in Wyoming Territory)

claims.statement: Tom Allen said Mike McCoole was very good as a private citizen but stood No. 3 as a fighter, and had a bad crowd of backers.

notes: The deposit requirement is printed as 'not less than $140' (hint said $100); the paper named is garbled, so it is not recorded as a claim.
